style: Professional industrial product photography, dramatic side lighting, deep shadows, anthracite-and-warm-yellow color palette, high detail, photorealistic, magazine quality, shot on Sony A7 with 35 mm lens, no logos, no text on container.

images.prompt: Wide cinematic photograph of a German waste-management container yard at golden hour. Multiple yellow industrial roll-off containers and skips arranged in neat rows, a forklift in the mid-ground, a stacked row of shipping containers in the background. Anthracite asphalt, low warm sun, long shadows, fine atmospheric haze. Premium industrial mood, no people, no text.

Two engineers in clean industrial uniforms with subtle yellow accents inspecting a row of brand-new yellow steel waste containers in a German manufacturing hall. Cinematic side light from large factory windows, polished concrete floor, organised production line in the background. Documentary photography, photorealistic.

Single rectangular yellow industrial waste collection container with two-wheel base and dark grey lid, placed on an anthracite concrete floor. Studio lighting, neutral grey gradient backdrop, sharp product photography, light reflections on the steel surface.

Yellow steel roll-off container with reinforced ribs, three-quarter side view, parked on dark asphalt, soft overcast daylight, no truck, no background distractions, neutral grey backdrop, product photography style.

Modern modular site office container in clean light grey with anthracite trim and a single yellow accent stripe, two windows and a door with steps, three-quarter view, set on neutral concrete ground with a clean grey backdrop, daylight.
